FACTTRADE.name: FactTrade
FACTTRADE.description: contain all trade information for all stock and etf not non-etf fund. notice trade information not portfo latest data. notice customerKey should join on **DimCustomer_VC** to get customerCode.
FACTTRADE.query_explanation: tradeSideKey 1 means buy and 2  means sell. notice customerKey should join on **DimCustomer_VC** to get customerCode.

FACTCUSTOMERINVESTFUND.name: FactCustomerInvestFund
FACTCUSTOMERINVESTFUND.description: include trade information for non-etf funds
FACTCUSTOMERINVESTFUND.query_explanation: for getting customerKey and after that customerCode, this table should join with DimCustomerFund table by using investorId and fundKey in join condition.

DIMDATE.name: DimDate
DIMDATE.description: is a wrapper table which can be base for calculation of date, date in all above table is a key which can be join with this table
DIMDATE.query_explanation: to calculate diffrence of two dateKey you can calculate diff of dateId which gives diff in day. to calculate age for a customer use yearNo of birthDateKey and the DateKey then diff them. when user give a 8 digit number as a date use it as dateKey.

FACTPORTFOLIOLATEST.name: FactPortfolioLatest
FACTPORTFOLIOLATEST.description: include portfolio information for customers. its record every change on portfolio, etf and online stock, so we can calculate portfolio of a customer for a specific day. it has quantity field for each issuerKey, means stock
FACTPORTFOLIOLATEST.query_explanation: to calculate for a specific datekey condition is fromDateKey <= dateKey and  toDateKey > dateKey. quantity is clear for price on the specif dateKey this table should join with FactDailyIssuerIndex on issuerKey and use vwaPrice. when user want portfolio it means for all issuerKey which have a customer except customer with zero portfo and except quantity =0. when user limit the issuers user should provide issuerKeys list. to get customerCode this table should join with HubCustomer_VC on customerKey.

FACTPORTFOLIOMUTUALFUND.name: FactPortfolioMutualFund
FACTPORTFOLIOMUTUALFUND.description: FactPortfolioMutualFund include portfolio information for customers but this table is only for non etf funds. in persian صندوق های صدوری ابطالی. total portfo contain all fundKeys when fundKey is 1 or 2 portfo value called cashportfo, مانده موجودی,. so total portfo consist cashportfo+ portfo values for  other fundKey.
FACTPORTFOLIOMUTUALFUND.query_explanation: to calculate for a specific datekey condition is fromDateKey <= dateKey and  toDateKey >= dateKey. quantity is clear for price on the specif dateKey this table should join with FactDailyFund on fundKey.notice there are customers in this table which have not online and etf customer and vice vers so when user want total portfolio they should be consider. for get customerKey for this table use invesorId and fundky then join on DimcustomerFund.

FACTDAILYISSUERINDEX.name: FactDailyIssuerIndex
FACTDAILYISSUERINDEX.description: include price for a issuer, issuerKey, in daily time frame. for price use vwaPrice field
FACTDAILYISSUERINDEX.query_explanation: to calculate for a specific datekey condition is fromDateKey <= dateKey and  toDateKey >= dateKey. use vwaPrice for price.

FACTDAILYFUND.name: FactDailyFund
FACTDAILYFUND.description: include price for a funds in daily time frame
FACTDAILYFUND.query_explanation: use sellNaV for price. notice fundKey 9 is equal to fundKey=10 in FactPortfolioMutualFund and there is no any fundKey 9 in FactPortfolioMutualFund so in join condition it should be consider.

DIMCUSTOMERFUND.name: DimCustomerFund
DIMCUSTOMERFUND.description: include customer information which there is for non-etf funds and FactPortfolioMutualFund table.
DIMCUSTOMERFUND.query_explanation: to get customerCode this table should join with HubCustomer_VC on customerKey.

HUBCUSTOMER_VC.name: HubCustomer_VC
HUBCUSTOMER_VC.description: is dimension of customers. include information of customers such as birthdate and city, etc, customerCode present a customer. customerKey in this table is used  FactPortfolioLatest and FactPortfolioMutualFund tables.
HUBCUSTOMER_VC.query_explanation: when partyTypeCode is 1 it means حقیقی. customerCode نمایان کر مشتری می باشد.

DIMCUSTOMER_VC.name: DimCustomer_VC
DIMCUSTOMER_VC.description: is dimension of customers. include information of customers such as birthdate and city, etc, customerCode present a customer. customerKey in this table is used in FactTrade table
DIMCUSTOMER_VC.query_explanation: when partyTypeCode is 1 it means حقیقی. customerCode نمایان کر مشتری می باشد.

DIMISSUER.name: DimIssuer
DIMISSUER.description: is dimensional table for online and etf issuers, the primary key is issuerKey.Also each issuerKey has a stockKey.
